channel.description: Latest articles from Pajhwok Afghan News (pajhwok.com)

item.title: 21 Afghans released from Pakistani prisons return home
item.description: The Ministry of Refugees and Repatriation (MoRR) on Thursday said 21 Afghan refugees, recently released from prisons in Pakistan, have returned to Afghanistan.

item.title: 8 cranes worth $1.5m purchased for customs offices
item.description: The Ministry of Finance (MoF) has purchased eight cranes worth nearly $1.5 million for six customs offices across Afghanistan.

item.title: 19 property dealing offices closed in Kabul over violations
item.description: The Ministry of Justice (MoJ) has closed 19 property dealing offices in Kabul last month due to violations and illegal activities.

item.title: 4 martyred, 3 injured in Pakistani strikes in Khost
item.description: Four members of a family, including women and children, were martyred and three others injured in Pakistani artillery and mortar strikes on the Alisher-Terezi district of southeastern Khost province on Thursday, an official said.

item.title: ‘If only we still had Bagram airbase’: US envoy Waltz
item.description: United States Permanent Representative to the United Nations Mike Waltz has highlighted the strategic importance of Bagram Airbase following claims that Iranian leaders may have moved towards areas near Afghanistan.
